critical_findings.label: Mission spec §3 'counter_payment_confirmed' / §5 'OrderPaidAtCounter' applies to Kiosk-at-counter path, NOT POS direct sale
critical_findings.detail: Two distinct backend paths share the same private-branch.{branchId} broadcast channel: (1) POS direct sale (cashier rings up + pays AT register) — writes audit_logs action='order.created.pos' + dispatches OrderCreated event. (2) Kiosk Cash-at-Counter deferred (customer chooses CASH on borne, hands money to cashier later via POST /api/admin/pos/counter-collect/{order}/confirm) — writes audit_logs action='order.counter_payment_confirmed' + dispatches OrderPaidAtCounter. Both paths feed the same HMAC chain + same KDS/OSS broadcast channel. The implementation is correct; the FLOW-2 mission spec conflated the two. Documenting here for the master-ultimate convergence report.
critical_findings.evidence: PaymentService.php L#392 (counter_payment_confirmed action name) + L#409 (OrderPaidAtCounter::dispatch — sole dispatcher). OrderService.php L#1187 (OrderCreated::dispatch for POS direct sale). audit_logs id=55 with action=order.created.pos LIVE.

critical_findings.label: transactions table empty for POS cash sale — expected by design, worth documenting
critical_findings.detail: OrderDetailsResource returned transaction=null for order #10. DB inspection confirms 0 rows in transactions WHERE order_id=10. This is correct per design: transactions table is for payment-gateway settlements (Stripe, Senangpay, etc.). POS cash sale records into cash_movements + audit_logs which is the NF525 cash-trail surface. A future reviewer might flag this as a data gap — documenting here for clarity.
critical_findings.evidence: DB select transactions WHERE order_id=10 → empty; OrderResource transaction field=null

critical_findings.label: expected_closing_amount on cash_drawer_sessions is computed at close, not maintained per-movement
critical_findings.detail: session #4 post-test: opening_amount=50.00, closing_amount=null, expected_closing_amount=null. The running expected (50 + 2 + 4 = 56) is NOT persisted on the session row after each cash_movement insert. Computation happens in CashDrawerService::computeExpected* / cash-overview view. This is correct per design (single-write column avoids race), but readers expecting per-write column update should note that the expected drawer balance is a derived value at read time. Mission §4 used 'recalculated' which could mislead — clarifying here.
critical_findings.evidence: DB select cash_drawer_sessions WHERE id=4 LIVE — closing/variance/expected all null post-write

critical_findings.label: receipt operator_name field carries the customer label, not the cashier
critical_findings.detail: OrderDetailsResource serializes operator_name='Client passage' (the walking customer user_id=2 name). The actual cashier attribution (creator_id=3, 'Caissier Le Cayenne') is on the audit_logs row payload.cashier_name. A receipt printed for NF525 audit will show the customer name in 'operator' position which is semantically odd. Audit chain has the right data; receipt rendering may want a dedicated cashier_name field for V1.0.2 polish. Not a NF525 compliance gap (chain is the source of truth).
